h: Lamine Yamal's four-year-old brother falls asleep at Ballon d'Or ceremony, drawing amused reactions
p: A video of Lamine Yamal's four-year-old brother dozing off during the Ballon d'Or ceremony has drawn amused reactions online. Many social media users shared the clip and joked about the late-night event.
more: Yamal finished runner-up to Harry Kane for the award.
The clip has been widely shared since the ceremony.
